name: Space Junk View VR
summary:
You're floating in space. Around you, the real junk.

Space Junk View VR drops you inside the live, real catalog of 31,000+ tracked objects orbiting Earth right now: active satellites, dead satellites, spent rocket bodies, and a vast cloud of debris. Every object is propagated with real SGP4 orbital mechanics to its true current position, streaming past you at a smooth 72 FPS. This isn't an artist's impression; it's the actual sky, computed from public tracking data, with the right things in the right place
